entries.subject: PDS ISS calibrated frames with registered viewing geometry
entries.finding: Original PDS ISS calibrated frames plus the model release's registered viewing geometry. The 2017 closest-flyby images provide the strongest available detail in the qualified footprint.

entries.subject: PDS plate model
entries.finding: PDS plate model, supplying both real geometry and the complementary radial-height view.

entries.subject: NASA press portraits
entries.finding: NASA press portraits ([Atlas overview](https://science.nasa.gov/saturn/moons/atlas/)) reuse the Cassini observations; directly calibrated frames preserve their original coordinates and numerical pixels.
entries.revisitWhen: A press product adds pixels or registration that the calibrated frames lack.

entries.subject: USGS/DLR Cassini global mosaics and regional papers
entries.finding: The USGS/DLR standard Cassini global-mosaic series does not supply a downloadable registered Atlas map in the inspected release. Papers on these small moons provide regional geological and compositional interpretation; no corresponding global scalar raster was identified for this package. This is a bounded survey, not a claim that no further data exists.
entries.revisitWhen: A downloadable registered Atlas map or global scalar raster is found.

entries.subject: Southern IR3/GRN/UV3 sequence camera mismatch
entries.finding: Native products N1560303721_1, N1560303490_1 and N1560303424_1 were acquired and the published shape-camera rows tried. The green projection put about 98% of predicted illuminated shape pixels onto sky. Its published center is inconsistent with the observed crescent. No guessed pointing correction or surface expansion is included. This is a failed candidate trial, not a rejection of the native images.
entries.revisitWhen: A corrected authoritative camera row or an independent controlled registration resolves the pointing mismatch.

entries.subject: Selected calibrated Cassini filter-color observations
entries.finding: The selected IR3/GRN/UV3 sequence supplies False color through its published shape-camera rows. Each calibrated band keeps its own viewing geometry; shared sRGB display encoding does not establish natural color or eliminate relief-edge fringes.
